purpose: Additional safe symptom entry points mapped to existing validated catalog cases; not new diagnoses or routes

guides.title: Game controller lights up but buttons do nothing
guides.heading: Peripherals & Devices
precautions: Stop the game before unplugging a controller.
comparison: Check whether the controller appears in the local input-device results; a lit LED only shows that it has power.
If the controller appears, compare its response in a game-independent input tester before changing any game settings.
interpretations: Detection and working button events are different things. Do not replace the controller based on its LED.

guides.title: Controller works on desktop but not in a game
guides.heading: Peripherals & Devices
precautions: Avoid changing global input mappings while another game uses the controller.
comparison: Confirm the game is focused and that it supports the controller type.
Compare the controller in a second game or safe input-testing application, if already installed.
interpretations: If input works outside the affected game, game mapping or game-specific compatibility deserves attention.

guides.title: USB mouse moves but clicks do not work
guides.heading: Peripherals & Devices
precautions: Do not repeatedly click destructive buttons while testing.
comparison: Check whether pointer movement and scrolling work independently of mouse clicks.
If available, try a known working mouse without changing your system settings.
interpretations: Movement does not prove that all button events work.

guides.title: Some keyboard keys type the wrong characters
guides.heading: Peripherals & Devices
precautions: Do not enter a password while the key mapping is uncertain.
comparison: Compare the selected keyboard layout with the markings on your physical keyboard.
Test a non-sensitive phrase in a text editor, including the affected keys.
interpretations: A keyboard-layout mismatch is different from a disconnected keyboard.

guides.title: Webcam picture is black in video calls
guides.heading: Peripherals & Devices
precautions: Do not record or share camera images without permission.
comparison: Check the webcam privacy shutter or hardware camera switch.
Compare with another already-installed camera application if available; do not install one only for this test.
interpretations: A detected webcam may still be blocked by privacy, app permissions or unsupported capture settings.

guides.title: Headset microphone works in one app but not another
guides.heading: Audio & Devices
precautions: Do not make or share test recordings containing private conversations.
comparison: Check that the affected app is using the intended input source and is not muted.
Compare a short user-approved local test with the app in which the microphone works.
interpretations: A working microphone in another app points toward app-specific configuration, not a proven hardware fault.

guides.title: Bluetooth headphones connect but play no sound
guides.heading: Audio & Bluetooth
precautions: Begin with a low volume before switching outputs.
comparison: Check which audio output is currently selected and whether the headset is connected for audio, not just paired.
Compare with the built-in speakers without removing the existing pairing.
interpretations: Pairing alone does not mean audio is routed to the headset.

guides.title: Bluetooth headset microphone sounds distorted
guides.heading: Audio & Bluetooth
precautions: Stop an active call before changing audio profiles.
comparison: Check whether quality changes only when the microphone becomes active.
Compare headset output and microphone behavior without clearing its pairing.
interpretations: Bluetooth audio profiles can trade playback quality for microphone support; do not assume a faulty headset.

guides.title: Speakers play sound but one side is silent
guides.heading: Audio & Bluetooth
precautions: Keep volume low to protect hearing and speakers.
comparison: Check the left/right balance and whether an application is sending mono or stereo audio.
If external speakers have removable cables, inspect connections while they are powered off.
interpretations: A silent channel may be caused by balance, source, cable or speaker hardware.

guides.title: Screen flickers when an external monitor is connected
guides.heading: Graphics & Display
precautions: Avoid frequent cable switching while sensitive work is open.
comparison: Check whether flickering affects only the external monitor or also the built-in display.
Compare a supported refresh rate or a known suitable cable, one change at a time.
interpretations: A flicker does not identify the graphics card as faulty.

guides.title: External monitor is detected but remains black
guides.heading: Graphics & Display
precautions: Do not change multiple display settings at once.
comparison: Confirm that the monitor is powered on and using the correct input.
Check whether the system sees the display and whether the desktop has assigned it an active output.
interpretations: A detected monitor and an active video signal are separate observations.

guides.title: Laptop brightness keys do nothing
guides.heading: Graphics & Display
precautions: Avoid changing kernel options as a first step.
comparison: Compare the brightness slider in the desktop settings with the laptop function keys.
Check whether the screen actually changes brightness or only the displayed slider value.
interpretations: The keyboard shortcut, backlight interface and screen hardware can fail independently.

guides.title: Games freeze but the desktop still works
guides.heading: Graphics & Display
precautions: Save other open work before reproducing a freeze.
comparison: Check whether the issue affects only one game or other graphics-intensive applications too.
Compare a normal gameplay attempt with the latest matching graphics errors, if any.
interpretations: A game freeze alone cannot distinguish a game problem, graphics driver or hardware issue.

guides.title: Laptop battery drains while plugged in
guides.heading: Hardware & Power
precautions: If a charger or connector is unusually hot or damaged, stop using it safely.
comparison: Check whether the power adapter is detected and whether the battery reports charging, discharging or full.
Compare behavior at rest and under normal usage, without deliberately stressing the computer.
interpretations: A low-power adapter may be detected but unable to keep up with demand.

guides.title: Computer wakes immediately after going to sleep
guides.heading: Hardware & Power
precautions: Save work before testing suspend.
comparison: Check whether sleep lasts at all or whether the computer wakes after a short delay.
If safe, note whether a USB device or dock is connected when the problem occurs.
interpretations: Wake sources, desktop power settings and firmware remain distinct possibilities.

guides.title: Laptop fan is loud when nothing is running
guides.heading: Hardware & Power
precautions: Do not open the computer or touch moving fans during operation.
comparison: Compare idle CPU activity with available temperature and fan-speed readings.
Check whether background updates are still running before assuming an airflow problem.
interpretations: A fast fan does not automatically mean overheating or a faulty fan.

guides.title: External SSD appears but files cannot be saved
guides.heading: Storage & Filesystems
precautions: Protect important files before trying any repair.
comparison: Check whether the drive was mounted read-only and whether the affected folder allows writing.
Compare file access without formatting, remounting or changing ownership.
interpretations: A mounted drive can still be read-only because of permissions or filesystem errors.

guides.title: USB drive keeps disappearing during file copies
guides.heading: Storage & Filesystems
precautions: Stop repeated writes when the drive disconnects or reports I/O errors.
comparison: Check whether the disconnection corresponds to the affected drive in recent local device events.
If the data is backed up and the drive is safe to disconnect, compare a direct port with the existing hub.
interpretations: Power, cable and device faults are possibilities, not confirmed causes.

guides.title: Disk shows free space but saving still fails
guides.heading: Storage & Filesystems
precautions: Do not delete system directories to make room.
comparison: Check available space on the actual writable data partition, not only the root filesystem summary.
Check for a user quota or an exhausted inode count if the filesystem supports it.
interpretations: Reported free bytes on one filesystem do not prove the target folder is writable.

guides.title: External drive asks to be formatted
guides.heading: Storage & Filesystems
precautions: Do not click Format when important data may be on the drive.
comparison: Check whether the device appears in storage inventory and whether its filesystem type is recognized.
Preserve the original device untouched if the data is valuable or recovery may be needed.
interpretations: A format prompt is not proof that the disk is empty or irreparably damaged.

guides.title: Browser opens but every page stays blank
guides.heading: Internet & Network
precautions: Do not reset all network settings on the basis of one browser symptom.
comparison: Check whether the browser can open its own settings and an existing local page.
Check the browser proxy mode and any active extension only after confirming the rest of the network works.
interpretations: A blank page can be browser-specific even when DNS resolution succeeds.

guides.title: Only one website fails to open
guides.heading: Internet & Network
precautions: Do not change system-wide DNS settings for one failing website.
comparison: Compare the exact site address with a different known website, only if you choose to make a network request.
Notice whether the browser shows a certificate, name-resolution or access error.
interpretations: A single failing site does not prove the internet connection is down.

guides.title: Ethernet shows connected but there is no internet
guides.heading: Internet & Network
precautions: Avoid disconnecting a working remote session.
comparison: Check whether the wired connection has a valid local address and default route.
Check whether the failure is to the router, to name lookup or only to the browser.
interpretations: An active Ethernet link is not proof that websites are reachable.

guides.title: Internet works but video calls keep freezing
guides.heading: Internet & Network
precautions: Avoid transferring private call logs without review.
comparison: Check whether the issue happens on all calls or only in one app.
Compare ordinary connection stability and device audio/video performance before changing router settings.
interpretations: Call freezes can come from network jitter, application load or media-device problems.

guides.title: Wi-Fi connects but disconnects after sleep
guides.heading: Internet & Network
precautions: Avoid disabling security features as a first step.
comparison: Check whether the Wi-Fi adapter is present and enabled after waking.
Compare the connection state before and after a normal sleep/resume cycle if safe.
interpretations: A dropped connection after sleep does not establish a bad password or broken adapter.

guides.title: An app opens but the window is empty
guides.heading: Applications & Services
precautions: Save work in other windows before testing.
comparison: Check whether the process remains running while its window is blank.
Compare the issue with another account or a fresh app session only if practical without modifying user data.
interpretations: A visible window does not guarantee that the application has loaded its content.

guides.title: Application opens off-screen or behind another window
guides.heading: Applications & Services
precautions: Do not delete desktop configuration files to restore a window.
comparison: Check whether the app appears in the taskbar or running-app list.
If possible, use the desktop window menu to bring or move the window into view.
interpretations: A hidden or off-screen window is not the same as a failed application start.

guides.title: Steam game launches then closes immediately
guides.heading: Applications & Services
precautions: Do not remove prefixes or saved games before making backups.
comparison: Check whether the failure is limited to one title and which compatibility runtime it uses.
Compare with another already-installed game and look for fresh, matching app errors.
interpretations: One game failing does not prove a broken GPU driver.

guides.title: App stops responding after opening a file
guides.heading: Applications & Services
precautions: Protect the original document before reproducing the problem.
comparison: Check whether the app can open another known safe document of the same format.
Compare the affected file from a local folder if supported and without editing the original.
interpretations: A file-specific failure may differ from an application-wide crash.

guides.title: Audio stops working in a video meeting
guides.heading: Audio & Devices
precautions: Do not record a private meeting to test the microphone.
comparison: Check separately whether playback and microphone input fail.
Verify which devices the meeting app has selected and whether microphone access is permitted.
interpretations: A call-specific audio problem does not prove that the system sound service is broken.

guides.title: Notifications are silent even though music plays
guides.heading: Audio & Devices
precautions: Avoid changing the entire sound server configuration.
comparison: Check that system notifications are enabled and their stream is not muted.
Check whether application audio and system notification audio use different outputs.
interpretations: Working music playback does not confirm notification routing.

guides.title: Screen sharing shows a black image
guides.heading: Desktop & Display
precautions: Do not share private screen contents during tests.
comparison: Check whether the desktop is using a Wayland or X11 session and whether a screen-sharing chooser appears.
Confirm that the affected app has permission to capture the intended window or screen.
interpretations: A black capture is not proof that the graphics card is faulty.

guides.title: Copy and paste stops working between applications
guides.heading: Desktop & Display
precautions: Avoid copying passwords or private information during diagnosis.
comparison: Try copying a harmless short phrase between two already-open applications.
Check whether only one app is affected or whether clipboard contents disappear after closing a source app.
interpretations: Clipboard problems can involve sandboxing, session protocols or app behavior.

guides.title: Desktop icons or fonts look unusually large
guides.heading: Desktop & Display
precautions: Write down existing display scaling settings before changing anything.
comparison: Check whether desktop scaling, application scaling or text size is responsible.
If safe, compare one supported scaling value and restore the original if it does not help.
interpretations: A scaling mismatch is not necessarily a broken display driver.

guides.title: Flatpak app cannot see files on an external drive
guides.heading: Flatpak & AppImage
precautions: Do not grant the app access to the entire home folder as a first step.
comparison: Check the exact external folder the app needs and which filesystem it is mounted on.
Review the app permissions in the desktop interface without changing them automatically.
interpretations: A working drive outside the sandbox does not prove the sandbox can access it.

guides.title: Flatpak app launches but cannot open a file picker
guides.heading: Flatpak & AppImage
precautions: Do not replace portal packages or desktop services without confirming the error.
comparison: Check whether the file chooser fails for only this app or several sandboxed apps.
Review the currently active desktop session and portal service status.
interpretations: A missing chooser can be app-specific or portal-related.

guides.title: AppImage starts but its icon is missing
guides.heading: Flatpak & AppImage
precautions: Do not change system launcher directories without a reason.
comparison: Check whether the AppImage starts from its existing file location.
Check whether a desktop shortcut actually exists and points to the correct file.
interpretations: Missing launcher integration does not mean the AppImage binary is broken.

guides.title: An app says permission denied when opening a file
guides.heading: Security & Permissions
precautions: Do not use recursive administrator-level ownership changes as a first step.
comparison: Check the exact path and the app installation source; sandbox restrictions differ from host permissions.
Compare access to a harmless file that belongs to your account.
interpretations: A permission error does not prove a filesystem fault.

guides.title: System update downloads but never finishes
guides.heading: System, Boot & Updates
precautions: Do not reboot during an active package transaction without checking its state.
comparison: Check whether the updater is still working or waiting for input.
Check whether the installed system uses an atomic image or a conventional package manager.
interpretations: A slow download is not automatically a failed update.

guides.title: Login screen appears again after entering password
guides.heading: System, Boot & Updates
precautions: Do not delete your user configuration as a first attempt.
comparison: Check whether the login screen accepts the password but returns before the desktop appears.
Compare session type only if the login screen safely offers a choice.
interpretations: A login loop can involve session startup, home permissions or graphics issues.

guides.title: Computer takes a long time to shut down
guides.heading: System, Boot & Updates
precautions: Save work before another shutdown test.
comparison: Check whether the delay occurs before the display turns off or after it goes blank.
Review only the bounded, recent shutdown-related events available to the app.
interpretations: One delayed shutdown does not identify the service responsible.

guides.title: Virtual machine opens but has no network access
guides.heading: Virtual Machines & Containers
precautions: Do not change host firewall or network configuration without a confirmed reason.
comparison: Check whether the host has a working connection and whether the VM has a virtual network adapter.
Check which virtual network the VM is attached to, without deleting it.
interpretations: A host connection working does not prove the guest network is configured.

guides.title: Virtual machine fails after a host update
guides.heading: Virtual Machines & Containers
precautions: Do not delete VM disks or snapshots to diagnose startup.
comparison: Check whether the virtualization service is available after the update.
Check for a current error associated with the exact virtual machine.
interpretations: A host update may coincide with the failure without necessarily causing it.

guides.title: Podman container cannot reach the internet
guides.heading: Virtual Machines & Containers
precautions: Do not switch to privileged containers as a quick fix.
comparison: Check whether network access fails only inside the container or also on the host.
Check the container network configuration without changing ports or firewall rules.
interpretations: Host DNS success does not prove that the container has a working route.

guides.title: Python virtual environment cannot import a package
guides.heading: Development Tools
precautions: Avoid system-wide pip installation to repair a single project environment.
comparison: Check which Python interpreter the project runs and which environment contains the module.
Check whether the application uses its own virtual environment or a distribution-managed Python.
interpretations: A package installed for one interpreter may be unavailable to another.

guides.title: Git asks for credentials on every fetch
guides.heading: Development Tools
precautions: Never paste access tokens or private keys into logs.
comparison: Check whether the remote uses SSH or HTTPS and which account is expected.
Check that a credential helper or SSH agent is available, without exposing stored secrets.
interpretations: A repeated prompt can reflect credential storage or remote access requirements.

guides.title: Printer prints blank pages
guides.heading: Audio & Devices
precautions: Stop printing repeated blank pages to avoid wasting supplies.
comparison: Check whether the printer reports any ink, toner or paper problems.
Compare its built-in test page with a document printed from Linux, if the device supports this safely.
interpretations: A built-in test page working but Linux pages staying blank suggests a driver, document or print-option difference.

guides.title: Laptop camera is missing after an update
guides.heading: Peripherals & Devices
precautions: Do not disable privacy safeguards to force camera access.
comparison: Check the physical privacy switch and whether the local hardware inventory still lists a camera.
Compare any fresh camera-related error with the affected application and update time.
interpretations: A missing app camera menu is not proof that the camera hardware vanished.

guides.title: Browser refuses access to microphone
guides.heading: Audio & Devices
precautions: Avoid recording private speech unless you choose to.
comparison: Check the microphone permission for the exact site or application.
Check whether the correct microphone is selected and that the application is not muted.
interpretations: An app-level permission block can exist while the microphone works elsewhere.

guides.title: Only one headphone speaker works
guides.heading: Audio & Bluetooth
precautions: Start with low volume.
comparison: Check the left/right balance and whether the problem occurs with more than one audio source.
For a removable analogue cable, check the plug and use a known working cable if available.
interpretations: A silent headphone channel is not automatically a Linux driver error.

guides.title: Bluetooth disappears after reboot
guides.heading: Audio & Bluetooth
precautions: Keep another input method if you rely on a Bluetooth keyboard.
comparison: Check whether the adapter is visible in the local hardware inventory after reboot.
Compare the radio-block status with the desktop Bluetooth toggle without resetting devices.
interpretations: A missing toggle can reflect adapter detection, firmware or service state.

guides.title: Touchpad moves the cursor but taps do not click
guides.heading: Audio & Devices
precautions: Do not open the laptop or change internal hardware.
comparison: Check whether pointer movement works and whether only tapping or gestures fail.
Compare the desktop touchpad click and gesture settings to their previous values.
interpretations: Working movement suggests a more specific input or settings problem than a missing device.

guides.title: Game starts with a black screen but sound plays
guides.heading: Applications & Services
precautions: Avoid resetting graphics drivers or deleting game files before preserving saves.
comparison: Check whether the game still responds to input or audio while the image is black.
Compare windowed and full-screen behavior only if the game already offers those options.
interpretations: A black game window is not proof of a whole-system graphics failure.

guides.title: USB-C dock charges laptop but monitor stays dark
guides.heading: Peripherals & Devices
precautions: Stop storage transfers before swapping dock cables.
comparison: Check that the laptop USB-C port and cable support video output, not only charging.
Compare whether the monitor works directly with the laptop using a supported connection.
interpretations: Charging through a dock does not prove video mode support.

guides.title: Second monitor changes position after reconnecting
guides.heading: Graphics & Display
precautions: Save any open work before changing the display layout.
comparison: Check whether the display is detected with the expected model and connector.
Compare the current display arrangement with the intended position in desktop settings.
interpretations: A changed layout is different from a failed video signal.

guides.title: An application shows the wrong language
guides.heading: Applications & Services
precautions: Do not delete language packs without identifying the affected application.
comparison: Check whether other applications use the expected language.
Compare the app language preference and available locale settings without changing them automatically.
interpretations: An app-specific setting may differ from the desktop language.
